title: finding(app-shell): Studio's Interfaces pillar deletes its own `?sel=nav:ID` deep link on mount, so the shareable nav-item URL never opens nav editing
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with a named site, class (a). `reach:` a public door, the pillar's own shareable deep link (objectui#2272).
- **Measured.** The objectui#11136 dev ran an uncommitted probe that mounted the real `InterfacesPillar` under a `MemoryRouter` at a `?sel=nav:ID` URL on a writable package. Nav editing never opened: there was no Done toggle, and the rail showed the page form. The run was in happy-dom, not a browser.
- **Confirmed at source.** PR objectui#11152's contract review (`5900515190`, ③) confirmed the mechanism at its head `49b14e79b`.

Reader: triage first (grade and route), then the seat that dispatches it. Filed by `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_011p7ikEivgXefNDaE5S5Uec`) at the ACCEPT of PR objectui#11152 (objectui#11136), from the dev report's `out_of_scope_findings[0]`. The review judged it a separate class from that card (navigation, not read-only) that needs its own carrier. ⛔ Not graded here.

## The site (read at objectui `origin/main` `1d6a23d60`, `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`)

- **The apply effect** (`:1597-1605`) returns early on `navTree.length === 0` without recording the param. On mount the app draft is `{}`, so `navTree` is `[]`.
- **The mirror effect** (`:1606-1617`) is keyed on `[navSel]`. Its mount pass runs with `navSel` null and calls `next.delete(DESIGNER_SEL_PARAM)` with `replace: true`.
- **The result.** When the app draft resolves, `navSelParam` is already null, so the apply effect never fires. The deep link objectui#2272 documents is dead.
- **A latent second defect.** The apply effect calls `setEditNav(true)` without reading `readOnly`. Once the link works, a read-only package would enter nav editing, whose autosave is blocked on `readOnly`: the objectui#11124 / objectui#11136 class. The repair must gate it on `readOnly`. It cannot be reached today because the link is dead.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

- The mirror effect must not clear `sel` before the param has been applied, or before the nav tree has loaded. For example, skip the mirror while an unapplied `navSelParam` is pending, or record the param before the tree loads and apply it once the tree arrives.
- `setEditNav(true)` is gated on `readOnly`: on a read-only package the link selects the item without entering editing.
- Pins:
  - a `?sel=nav:ID` URL on a writable package opens nav editing on that item after the draft loads, and the URL keeps the param;
  - a read-only package's link selects the item without editing;
  - an unknown id changes nothing (the control).

Serial: `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` is also objectui#11148's file (the nav-item inspector's label map), a different component.

## Dedupe

The 1173 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs, open and closed (down to #2231; the 100 newest fetched now), were grepped:
- `sel=nav`: 1 hit, PR objectui#11152 (the source).
- `parseNavSelParam`, `appliedNavSelRef` and `DESIGNER_SEL_PARAM`: 0 hits each.
- `deep link … nav|Interfaces`: 4 hits (PR objectui#11152, and three action autoTrigger PRs about a different deep link).

No card covers this.
